name: identity_brand_update
title: Set the account brand name
description: App-only Brand Studio write. Sets the account's brand display name — the starter-brand wordmark shown in FX previews, Signature Studio start points, and rendered openers/outros. Account-level: every project of the account picks it up. project_id is present for an update from a project FX tab and absent from the account FX home. An empty brand_name clears the override back to the creator-name default. Project-addressed updates refresh prewarm when an identity is applied so preview media re-bakes with the new name.

project_id.description: Optional project public ID. When omitted, the current account owner is the authorization boundary.

brand_name.description: Brand display name, 60 characters max. Empty string clears the override.
